notes: kb/Work PB5130 (landed). §1989:A.2.16.3 AR1 a. "It must be an integer greater than 1600" bounds the year below only. At --std 85 DialectBehavior.IntegerDateFormBounded (2002) is inactive, the binder sets BoundIntrinsicCall.IntegerDateFormUnbounded and CobolDate.IntegerOfDate counts Gregorian days arithmetically with no upper year: INTEGER-OF-DATE (100000101) is 3067672 and (100001231) 3068037; a month or day outside its range, or a year of 1600 or less, is still the incorrect-argument default 0. Witness pb5130_integer_date_year_10000_85.

next.reason: Form YYYYMMDD, the calculation and the MM/DD limits are identical, but 1989 bounds the year only below ('an integer greater than 1600') while §2023:15.46.3 AR1 says 'greater than 1600 and less than 10000'. The 1989 value is defined by the calculation (YYYY * 10,000) + ..., which is valid for YYYY >= 10000, and no 1989 rule caps it; such an argument is now out of range (EC-ARGUMENT-FUNCTION per §2023:15.3 AR14). Stricter.
